denominator.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT feature_index)::int AS features FROM {parcel_table} WHERE county_fips = $1
denominator.basis: count(DISTINCT feature_index) in txgio_parcel for the county (falling back to txgio_parcel_staging). The FEATURE is the real-world parcel; raw row count understates coverage when multiple rows share a feature_index.
denominator.nullDenominatorOutcome: railState=not-yet; never satisfied-absent from a null denominator alone

numerator.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT split_part(entity_id, ':', 1) || ':' || split_part(entity_id, ':', 2))::int AS parcels_determined FROM atoms WHERE entity_type = 'special-district-fact' AND entity_id >= $countyFips AND entity_id < $countyFipsUpperBound
numerator.basis: DISTINCT parcel keys with at least one special-district-fact atom (entity_id FIPS prefix before the :sd: family suffix). Determination coverage, NOT raw atom row count — a parcel may carry present membership, typed sd:outside absence, or multiple district rows.

excludeFromNumerator.reason: County-level marker is not a parcel; L7 addendum — never enter a parcel ratio

numerator.overcountRule: numerator > denominator => railState=not-yet with honest unclamped ratio (SF-25; same engine path as footprint and pipelines)

absenceProbe.refusal: Counties outside reach refuse absence (N/A for statewide). Empty basis or missing table => not-yet, not absent.

honestEmptyRules.when: tx_special_district has zero rows for county_fips AND absenceProbe covers county
atoms store holds entity_id '{countyFips}:_county_coverage' with special-district-fact typed county determination (e.g. Robertson 48395 CROSSWALK_HOLD)
honestEmptyRules.outcome: satisfied-absent, honestCoveragePct=0, source=special-district-fact:_county_coverage; NEVER read as 1/N parcel ratio
